name: mordred-burnished-avenger-inherited-first-attack-costs-two-less
notes: Mordred, Burnished Avenger (OWCdWq3mXY): "[Mordred Bonus] Inherited Effect -- As long as Mordred has leveled up this turn, the first attack card you activate this turn costs 2 less to activate." (CalculateActivationReserveCost: ChampionHasInLineage(OWCdWq3mXY) + the LEVELED_UP_THIS_TURN global effect + no attack card activated yet.) The champion is patched to Burnished Avenger (level 1) and performs a REAL level-up into Mordred, Flawless Blade (2 memory cards): the effect is inherited because Burnished Avenger is in the lineage. Striking Tides (printed reserve 3) is then activated and needs exactly ONE reserve payment.

rulesClauses: [Mordred Bonus] Inherited Effect: as long as Mordred has leveled up this turn, the first attack card you activate this turn costs 2 less to activate.
